description: REPAIR of art2 in the gemini staged arm. It truncated twice: first with thinking uncapped (62,912 thinking / 2,610 answer, stopped at the model's 65,536 ceiling), then at a 24,576 cap (8,189 / 16,371). art2 is the biggest article in the set — 135 entities feed its reification — so it needs the model's full output budget WITH thinking capped, or reasoning eats the answer. nb7b then grafts it onto the finished 20-article vocabulary: fresh=false so the vocabulary survives, inline vocab so it reuses existing terms, consolidate=false because a fresh pass would overwrite the cumulative merge report and strand the other 19 articles.
